{{Top|leg}}
The '''SF-12 capacitor component''' was produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The SF-12 increased a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] rate of fire by feeding energy into both the weapons and augmented cooling systems, and had a reputation for being reliable and safe.
